thread:
sam: Heads-up — partner enablement sync. We need a single set of "IaC kits" for cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) that include reference arch, Terraform modules, and a packaging checklist.
ellie: +1. Do we want separate repos per cloud or monorepo with submodules? Thoughts on ownership?
rahul: Prefer monorepo with clear subdirs: /aws /azure /gcp. Easier to keep naming / testing consistent. Owner per cloud to handle marketplace-specific bits.
jenny: Agree monorepo. We should also include a lightweight e2e job that validates publishable artifacts (terraform init/plan, marketplace metadata lint).
mike: I'll take AWS ownership. Proposed deliverables by EOW: module skeleton, README template, CI job example, and example reference-arch diagram.
ellie: @mike can you add the packaging checklist items for AWS Marketplace (AMI/VM/Container differences + listing manifest)? I can draft Azure/GCP checklists.
rahul: CI snippet idea:
```
jobs:
  validate_iac:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: terraform init ./aws/module
      - run: terraform validate ./aws/module
```
jenny: infra-bot just created a template repo in org: https://git.redwood.internal/iac-partner-kits (infra-bot)
infra-bot: Repo skeleton created with branches: main, ci-templates, docs-internal. Seeded with LICENSE and CODEOWNERS.
sam: Nice. Add CODEOWNERS per cloud. Also we need a short onboarding doc for SIs: "how to consume the module, test locally, and packaging for marketplace".
mike: Will PR module skeleton + AWS checklist today. @ellie assign Azure/GCP checklists?
ellie: On it. I'll add a sample ARM/Bicep and Deployment Manager example.
jenny: Quick question — for TF module registry vs internal git modules: recommend we publish to Terraform Registry when GA? maybe first keep as git submodules for quick iteration.
rahul: Agreed. Start as git modules, include a release workflow and semver tags so publishing is easy later.
sam: Timeline recap: this week seed monorepo + owners; next week CI/e2e + checklist final; then partner review. :rocket:
ellie: Sounds good. Ping me in thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
